Explicit current-version heads have classes1..4; all absent and rare TRAIN classes remain reported and every declared head retained.
TRAIN eligibility uses three graph groups per observed class; graph families have unequal numbers of source relatives.
At site3 current definitions/versions/status are constants and future copy parents/graphs/output ancestry are undefined.
The keyed random control ties identical canonical visible prefixes; it is a sham task, not a lawful synthetic program or marginal-preserving donor permutation.
Only output-ancestor control tasks use the visible final query; other labels and random tasks are identical at sites7/8.
